snippet.title: The Rooster Files Launch Trailer (Hotline Miami 2 Level Editor)
snippet.description:
Download here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=768681272

Panic strikes the heart of Miami as horrific massacres take place during the night.  We've all seen this story a hundred times, however The Rooster Files takes a twist on your typical Hotline Miami story, as you can now play as both Jacket and the police who are trying to find him. After each level, return to the scene of the crime as the police and hunt for clues to track down the Rooster Man! Is it the work of a twisted serial killer? Or is his motives and morality more complex than that? Find out along side detective Manny Pardo to find out in:

THE ROOSTER FILES

(I promise the plot twist is NOT that Pardo's the Miami Mutilator) 

Featuring Custom Music, Modded Sprites and 9 levels from easy to very hard!
